subject: general
question:
The number of students in different classes of a school is shown in the following bar graph.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35f7d929a12140234e68cb000b470bc2f9ab8964a5ec6b254a76419b81a5b456.png] 

The maximum difference in the number of students in any two classes is what percentage of the number of students in Class 7 (correct to two decimal places)?
solution:
**Calculation**

The maximum difference is in the number of students of classes 10 and 7 = 68 - 44

= 24

The number of students in class 7 = 68

⇒ 24/68 × 100

⇒ 35.29%

**The maximum difference is 35.29% of the number of students in Class 7**.
